name: kb_986_Normalized

schema.description: ServiceReference holds a reference to Service.legacy.k8s.io

name.description: Name is the name of the service

namespace.description: Namespace is the namespace of the service

port.description: If specified, the port on the service that hosting webhook. Default to 443 for backward compatibility. `port` should be a valid port number (1-65535, inclusive).

description: Please update the deployment to reference the Service named **my-service** located in the **default** namespace. The webhook endpoint should be configured to use port **8443**, which is the port currently exposed by the service. Let me know once the changes have been applied so we can verify connectivity.
